functions.name: TOANSI
functions.description: Converts Unicode Bangla text to Bijoy (ANSI). Show the result with the SutonnyMJ font.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: A cell or range containing Unicode Bangla text

functions.name: TOUNICODE
functions.description: Converts Bijoy (ANSI) text to Unicode Bangla. Text that is already Unicode is returned unchanged.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: A cell or range containing Bijoy (ANSI) text
